admission_policy.clean_terminal: Runner completes or reaches an original solver budget without any external provider/transport denial or missing accounting. Artifact absence does not by itself prevent healthy continuation.
admission_policy.cutoff_scope: No additional outage-recovery admission after this cutoff. Healthy serial continuation remains authorized within original per-cell and global budgets.
admission_policy.parent_authorization: Continue untouched cells serially after a clean terminal recovery outcome. If service errors recur, at most two additional recovery admissions tonight, each after a 30-minute cooldown; preserve pending cells if recovery fails. No terminal reruns, model changes or cap resets.

admission_policy.scope: The original 25-task cohort; first seven attempts remain immutable. This policy governs admission timing for the remaining 18 tasks, after the currently active seventh cell finishes.
admission_policy.stop_outcome: After two recovery admissions are consumed and service failure persists, or recovery-admission cutoff is reached, leave untouched tasks explicitly pending_provider_availability. Never count pending tasks as attempted or zero-scored.
admission_policy.terminal_outcomes: Every original task gets at most one solver attempt. Recovered HTTP 503 requests stay inside the same conversation and existing request/time/dollar caps.
admission_policy.unknown_infrastructure: Stop admissions for diagnosis; do not automatically retry authentication, quota, malformed payload, missing accounting or unknown errors.
